description: Hyperion (ΥΠΕΡΙΩΝ) is the broadband connection quality assessment system of the Hellenic Telecommunications and Post Commission, Greece's telecoms regulator. Through hyperiontest.gr, fixed and mobile users test the speed and quality of their internet connection, either anonymously or as registered users who describe their subscription. The commission publishes the measurements of both groups as open data on the national portal data.gov.gr, processed so that no personal data remain (no IP address and no user location). The export is a CSV of about 1.2 MB, last modified in November 2025, with a 0.27 MB zip of all resources refreshed in June 2026; the portal lists the update frequency as continuous. Coverage: Greece. Format and access: CSV and ZIP downloads from data.gov.gr and its CKAN API, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: tests are self-selected and depend on home equipment and wifi; with locations removed, results cannot be mapped below whatever area fields the export keeps, which were not checked; the export may cover only part of the measurement history. Simulation uses: distributions of delivered fixed broadband speed against subscribed speed for Greek service models. Related records: the Bredbandskollen statistics for Sweden, the ANCOM Netograf internet quality data for Romania and the Measurement Lab data give comparable crowdsourced measurements.
